answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop cheap forgery. Each agent holds one plume, issued after a stake is locked. A beacon picks a random 5% each epoch to prove liveness in 30 seconds, each heartbeat signed with the agent's quill. Keeping 1,000 shells warm costs 40 units each, so 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 per epoch; one honest agent pays 40 and keeps its share. The fable that one script can be a crowd dies at the first check.
